newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares ease but pressure seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares ease but pressure seen limited.

text.p: Austrian shares trudged lower on Monday as sentiment was weighed down by weak leads from Europe's leading markets, but traders noted receding selling pressure and said the downside was limited.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips fell 6.55 points or 0.6 percent to close the day at 1,033.38. Among its constituents, 15 losers outnumbered four gainers, two issues were unchanged.
"We're very well supported on the downside and should move sideways from here," a trader said.
Most market participants an analysts expect the ATX to remain locked between 1,020 points and 1,040, the range it has been trading in since the end of July.

Chip producer Austria Mikro Systeme, or AMS, led the day's decliners, falling 27 schillings or 3.8 percent to close at 691. Trader said the share had little chance to break through strong resistance at 700 schillings.
High-grade steel maker Boehler Uddeholm was steady at 812 schillings ahead of the group's half-year results expected next Monday.
Hosiery and lingery maker Wolford topped the day's list of gainers, rising 60 schillings or 2.41 percent to finish at 2,550.0.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 2.07 points or 0.5 percent to 403.70.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for September delivery were down 7.2 points at 1,030.7.
